column1: # Story Run quest arcs that unlock Rare and Exceptional Remembrance lines (Design v2 Part II "Rarity categories", the roster's
# unlock routes). Built by tools/story/build-quest-arcs.mjs. One row per scene, in order; the last scene of an arc unlocks.
# arc|unlocks (Remembrance ids, comma)|act|beat 1|beat 2

stranded_dragonair|rm_dratini|2|A fisher at the lake shore says a Dragonair has been circling the same rocks for days, too weak to leave.|You find it caught in an old net, scales dull. It does not flee when you come close.

stranded_dragonair|rm_dratini|3|You bring berries and clean water each time you pass. The Dragonair's scales start to shine again.|Today it slips free of the last strands of net and rises over the water, calling once.

stranded_dragonair|rm_dratini|4|At the lake's edge a small Dratini waits where the Dragonair used to circle.|The Dragonair watches from the water as the Dratini follows you. It seems to be saying thank you. Dratini can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

peak_alpha|rm_bagon|3|Climbers whisper about an Alpha that rules the highest peak, and a little Bagon that keeps leaping at it from the cliffs.|You climb until the air is thin. On the summit the Alpha roars, and the Bagon jumps again.

peak_alpha|rm_bagon|4|You face the Alpha together with the tiny Bagon at your side. When the dust settles, the Alpha bows its head and leaves the peak.|Bagon stands at the cliff edge and, for once, does not jump. It looks at you instead. Bagon can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

ironvein_prototype|rm_beldum|2|In an abandoned Ironvein Combine lab, one console is still blinking. Something metal hums behind the glass.|A Beldum floats in a sealed chamber, labelled PROTOTYPE 0. Its eye follows you.

ironvein_prototype|rm_beldum|3|You find the lab's override code in a dusty notebook. The chamber hisses open.|Beldum hovers out, studies you for a long moment, and settles beside you. Beldum can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
fed_three_nights|rm_gible|2|A wild Gible keeps watching your camp from a sandy burrow, too wary to come close.|You leave a share of food at the burrow's mouth. In the morning it is gone.
fed_three_nights|rm_gible|3|The Gible is back, closer this time. You leave food again, and it eats while you watch.|It bites your bag on the way out. You decide to take that as friendship.

fed_three_nights|rm_gible|4|On the third night the Gible walks right into camp and curls up by the fire.|It is still asleep there when you pack up, and it follows you down the road. Gible can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

choir_ritual|rm_deino|3|At a Hollow Choir ritual site, the singing stops when you arrive. In the middle of the circle, a feral Deino is chained to a stone.|The chanters scatter into the dark. The Deino snaps at every sound.

choir_ritual|rm_deino|4|You speak to it, softly, until it stops snapping and listens to your voice. The chain falls away.|Deino follows the sound of your steps out of the ruin. Deino can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
rain_night|rm_goomy|2|On a night of heavy rain, something small and slimy is huddled under your tent flap.|A Goomy, shivering, though it is made of rain. It seems to have run from a bigger Pokémon.

rain_night|rm_goomy|3|You let it stay dry beside you until morning. When the rain stops, it does not leave.|Goomy slides after you, leaving a shiny trail, and seems quite proud of it. Goomy can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

training_camp|rm_jangmo_o|3|Your rival invites you to a mountain training camp. A young Jangmo-o is challenging every Pokémon there.|Your rival grins. "That one has fire. Think you can keep up with it?"

training_camp|rm_jangmo_o|4|You train with the Jangmo-o for three days. On the last, it clangs its scales at you and refuses to stay behind.|Your rival laughs. "Looks like it picked you." Jangmo-o can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
lost_dreepy|rm_dreepy|2|At dusk a Dreepy drifts into camp, looking for something it cannot name.|It keeps floating toward the hills, then back to you, as if asking you to come.
lost_dreepy|rm_dreepy|3|You follow it to an old shrine, lit by ghost-fire. Other Dreepy flicker in the dark.|One of them is its parent, a tired Dragapult. The family circles you once.

lost_dreepy|rm_dreepy|4|The Dragapult sends the little Dreepy back to you. It has decided you are its family now too.|Dreepy settles in your bag as if it has always been there. Dreepy can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

long_winter|rm_frigibax|3|Snow falls in the middle of summer on a mountain route. People call it the Long Winter, and they say a Frigibax causes it.|You find an Alpha Baxcalibur guarding the pass, and a small Frigibax hiding behind it.

long_winter|rm_frigibax|4|The Alpha is old and tired. When you stand your ground, it lets the snow stop and lies down to rest.|The little Frigibax waddles to you, and the pass begins to thaw. Frigibax can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
lucky_egg|rm_togepi|2|A Pokémon Breeder hands you a spotted egg. "It needs a calm road and a kind team. Can you carry it a while?"|The egg is warm and wobbles when the team is near.
lucky_egg|rm_togepi|3|You keep the egg close through every fight, never letting it get bumped.|At night you can hear a faint tapping from inside.

lucky_egg|rm_togepi|4|The shell cracks open and a Togepi tumbles out, giggling at the first thing it sees: you.|The Breeder smiles. "It chose well." Togepi can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

twin_burrow|rm_nidoran_f,rm_nidoran_m|2|A sinkhole has opened in a field. Two Nidoran, one blue and one purple, are trapped at the bottom.|They are trying to push each other up and both keep sliding back down.

twin_burrow|rm_nidoran_f,rm_nidoran_m|3|You lower a rope and lift them out, one after the other. They will not leave each other's side.|Both of them follow you, and neither will go without the other. Nidoran♀ and Nidoran♂ can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

lantern_vigil|rm_duskull|2|In an old graveyard, the lanterns go out one by one each night. A caretaker asks you to keep the first one lit.|You keep watch. Near midnight, a Duskull drifts by and stares into your lantern.
lantern_vigil|rm_duskull|3|At the second lantern the Duskull is waiting for you. It helps you keep the flame from the wind.|The caretaker says nobody has seen a Duskull help before.

lantern_vigil|rm_duskull|4|At the last lantern, the Duskull shows you an old grave with your family's name on it, then waits beside you.|When dawn comes, it follows you out of the graveyard. Duskull can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.

retired_uniform|rm_pawniard|3|After you beat a squad of grunts, a Pawniard steps out of their camp, wearing a scrap of an old team uniform.|It salutes you, the way it was taught to salute its old boss.

retired_uniform|rm_pawniard|4|You take the scrap of uniform from it and fold it away. The Pawniard looks lost, then stands at your side instead.|It does not wait for orders. It chose you. Pawniard can now be found in the Remembrance Archive.
